name: campus-safety-app
description: Crowdsourced Campus Safety App — Expo mobile client and Express/Firebase backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix mobile ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.check:rules: node -e "const r=require('./backend/database.rules.json');const f=require('./firebase.json');if(f.database.rules!=='backend/database.rules.json')throw new Error('firebase.json does not point at backend/database.rules.json');if(r.rules['.read']!==false||r.rules['.write']!==false)throw new Error('root rules must be false');console.log('rules ok')"
